summary: Eos Energy Enterprises, Inc. filed an 8-K furnishing preliminary Q2 2026 results and business updates. The company expects revenue of $68-$69M, a gross margin loss of 69%-73%, and total cash of ~$364M as of June 30, 2026. The update highlights manufacturing progress with two commercial production lines. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change event is described. This is a routine operational and financial disclosure.
